integration.rules: Intact receiver/interceptor/near-path priority, teammate possession, selection-circle retention, fall/disabled-player and keeper filters.
integration.boundary: Native single-user registry synchronized at tick boundaries. Original new_users ball_travel++ > select_cnt (10) cadence is 12 ticks; also used for loose-ball polling because DOS user_conts dispatch remains disconnected. Original reselect notifications trigger a next-tick check. Manual switching reserves one cadence; keeper possession/contact, dead balls and shootouts retain their dedicated adapters. auto_users_a/b stay zero outside the extracted selector calls; multiplayer registry and DOS input dispatch are not enabled.
